_doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the engine's cross-cutting safety policy (2026-07-14, mirrors the second-brain's shared-policy pattern: rules live as DATA in one file, consumers carry byte-identical fallbacks so a missing/corrupt file degrades to prior behaviour, never to open). EDIT RULES HERE, not in the consumers. Current consumers: engine/lib/comms.mjs (auto-send allowlist). Per-client OVERRIDES do not belong here — this is the shared engine floor; profile.yaml stays the per-client surface (outbound_policy, quiet_hours).

auto_send._doc: §0.4 gated-vs-auto-send law: the ONLY comms that may leave a box unattended. Everything else is drafted + gated (default-deny) and released only by an explicit Approve. Widening any of these three lists widens what can auto-send on EVERY client box — treat edits like a permissions change, not a config tweak.

backup._doc: Nightly encrypted state snapshot (engine/backup.mjs). Targets are stateDir-relative paths; missing ones are skipped. sentinel_files must exist non-empty inside the archive for the verify step to pass.
